mods.name: Player Disguise
mods.description:
Pick a name. Pick a skin. Become anybody.

Player Disguise lets you assume an alias and custom skin while playing. Chat, tab list, nameplate, and visuals update for everyone on the server. Ops keep full visibility through /whois and /namehistory for moderation.
Skins stay server-side with persistent claims, cooldowns on release, and zero outbound traffic.

releases.notes:
# v1.0.0 — Player Disguise (Minecraft 1.21.1)

First public release of **Player Disguise**: a custom-alias and skin system for servers, character-driven worlds, and anyone who wants a fresh in-game identity without leaving their account.

## Highlights

- **Client-side profile book.** Build a library of profiles with custom names and skin PNGs. Wide and slim model support, validated against vanilla specs (64×64 / 64×32, ≤64 KB) before they touch the server.
- **Server-wide visibility.** Once you join, everyone sees your alias and skin: chat, tab list, nameplates, F5 self-view.
- **Persistent claims & cooldowns.** Your alias and skin stay reserved across logouts. Switching profiles puts the previous alias on a per-player cooldown so a quick rejoin doesn't lose it.
- **Two-step skin handshake.** The server only requests skin data when it doesn't already have it cached, no re-uploading on every login.
- **Storage hygiene.** Server-side GC + LRU keep the skin cache bounded.
- **Admin lookup tools.** `/whois <alias>` (name-anchored) and `/namehistory <player>` (player-anchored) surface the full alias history for moderation. Standard `/ban`, `/kick`, etc. always operate on real names.
- **Anti-impersonation guards.** A player can never claim an alias matching another player's real Mojang name. If a real-name collision happens at join, the disguised player is temporarily kicked. Your real name is always your real name.

## Compatibility

| Mod | Status |
|---|---|
| [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) | ✅ Voice icons follow the disguised identity |
| [BlueMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/bluemap) | ✅ Map markers reflect the disguise |
| [JourneyMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/journeymap) | ✅ Map markers reflect the disguise |
| [Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads) | ✅ Chat avatars match the disguised skin |

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- NeoForge **21.1.219+**

## Install

Download `playerdisguise-1.0.0+1.21.1.neoforge.jar` below and drop it into your `mods/` folder. Install on both client and server.

## Data & privacy

Skin PNGs and aliases travel only between the modded client and the modded server you're joining. No external skin hosts, no third-party APIs, no telemetry. Vanilla servers see your real Minecraft identity by design.

## Reporting Issues

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/weaversworkshop/playerdisguise/issues). Please include your Player Disguise version, MC version, NeoForge version, and (if applicable) the compat mod versions you're running.
